summary.text: Jimmy Mason is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2023, representing District 66 in Chaves, Eddy and Lea counties.
Mason is ranking member of the House Rural Development, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee and also sits on the House Commerce and Economic Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Mason's occupation as self-employed and a district office in Artesia.
Between sessions, Mason serves in an advisory role on the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee and the Land Grant Committee.
